certification.name: Infosec Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Specialization
certification.description: Eight-course Infosec specialization reviewing the CISSP domains, with end-of-course assessments and a final practice exam. Course-based exam-preparation certificate; the proctored ISC2 CISSP exam is separate.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week.
